decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:5.0pt;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;
margin-left:18.0pt;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-align:justify"><span style="font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif;">The proposed first floor rear extension, in conjunction with the
existing unauthorised ground floor rear extension and existing rear dormer
extension, by reason of inappropriate design and cumulative excessive bulk and
massing would result in an unduly obtrusive and incongruous addition that would
subsume the original dwelling, &nbsp;would
poorly relate to the existing rear dormer and would appear visually obtrusive,
cramped and overbearing, detracting from the character of the original property
and &nbsp;the surrounding area. The first
floor rear extension would thereby unacceptably harm the character of the
original dwellinghouse and the visual amenities of the area, contrary to the
high quality design aspirations set out in The National Planning Policy
Framework (2024), policies D3 (D(1) and D(11)) of The London Plan (2021),
Policy CS1.B on the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Development
Management Local Plans Policies (2013) and Supplementary Planning Document:
Residential Design Guide (2010).</span><span style="font-family:&quot;PT Sans&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:18.0pt;text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;PT Sans&quot;,sans-serif">Insufficient
information has been provided regarding the impacts of the proposed development
on the existing TPO trees within the immediately adjacent neighbouring site 26
Flambard Road. As such, the Local Planning Authority is unable to determine whether
the proposal is contrary to Policy G7 of the London Plan (2021) and policy DM22
of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).<o:p></o:p></span></p>
